plan.summary: BRO-2618: the Globe Midsummer (a-midsummer-nights-dream-globe-west-end-2026) scores Dominic Cavendish's Telegraph review off a westendtheatre.com round-up digest (excluded as a round-up, so the Telegraph is missing from the Globe score). His real review (3/5, 'Shakespeare's Globe, London SE1, until Aug 29') sits misfiled under the Regent's Park Midsummer, already flagged wrongProduction, with a 93 derived from Regent's Park's 5/5 theatre.reviews stars. Keep the Globe file and point it at the Telegraph review; delete the misfiled duplicate (Regent's Park's own Telegraph review is Claire Allfree's, at the regents-park url).
steps: Misfiled duplicate of Cavendish's Globe review under the Regent's Park show; Regent's Park's Telegraph slot is Claire Allfree's review.
Globe file's url is the westendtheatre.com round-up; repair to the Telegraph review url (the collector refetches it).
Byline of the Telegraph review is Dominic Cavendish; Julianna Barnaby is the round-up author.
Cavendish rates it 3/5 (51-70 band): warm on the ensemble, reservations about the audience participation and lost darkness. 60.
